'''Rossi Kildaon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a double for [[Tzeel]], a member of the band [[Distraction]]. She was escorted off the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'' by [[Xydge]] as part of a security ploy to protect the band.
